primaryChecks.text: Saul and his men went to seek him. When David was told, he went down to the rock, and stayed in the wilderness of Maon. When Saul heard that, he pursued David in the wilderness of Maon.
primaryChecks.previousContext: They arose, and went to Ziph before Saul; but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah on the south of the desert.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain; and David hurried to get away for fear of Saul, for Saul and his men surrounded David and his men to take them.
primaryChecks.reasonJa: 固有名がまだ現れず、無名の岩への将来名遡及を避ける。

primaryChecks.text: So Saul returned from pursuing David, and went against the Philistines. Therefore they called that place Sela Hammahlekoth.
primaryChecks.previousContext: But a messenger came to Saul, saying, “Hurry and come, for the Philistines have made a raid on the land!”
primaryChecks.nextContext: David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.
primaryChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文がここで初めて場所をSela Hammahlekothと呼ぶ。
